title: V03: add owned-directory prefix stage preparation
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/h25-v03-prefix-stage-preparation`: the byte-unchanged frozen Unit07 `prepare_prefix_stage(request)` source, exact failed/intermediate/final history, and a registered replay of its 22 NEW preparer methods per normal/optimized profile. It actually owns descriptor-relative installation, installs P -> Q -> M -> JOBS/STAGE -> configuration/policy/selection DATA, and records its final attempted-operation bill after consumed cleanup. It never launches its output. The whole-DAG tests use explicitly inert fixture pins with the frozen restoration contexts.

The source checkpoint closes four of four conditional source components. No genuine complete C05, full V03, C07 interval, source/native/runtime/funding admission, complete physical fit, caller/parent exit, paid-profile gain or kappa improvement is established. Outside costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`. Original completion stays 43.5%,22/49; stage2/10; milestones1/10;24components/52helpers unchanged. The app goal is separately paused; guarded94.550533479/2400 is unapproved and is not a physical total.

## Task and overlap

Canonical preparation base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. This explicit source-publication assignment has changed scope from the provenance-only `portable-replay` catalogue card; no new scientific task was drawn.

Nearest supplied checkpoints: [PR6371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6371), entry head `8e772eadcbdee11289eb2eac887ffc15b864587c`, and [PR6370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6370), inputs head `e144f3b0a440fd33efdcfa4e0bd1af059dfd4fb3`. The separate [bounded caller PR6373](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6373), exact head `b91c5c74f252c1a98ab8344d012702170004ed13`, is submitted; the exact34,716-byte caller SHA256 `25138c2c998762649c6a61cb8a6ae8aacd81bd533591b082ab6f58def712fca2` is retained and hashed as inert archive data. Its separate11methods are excluded from this replay and count. No predecessor package is duplicated for provenance.

The export preserves source75bc/f8a/a2b/final25c, pre-freeze self-correction, initial failedcounterexamples, whole-DAG oracle21-to20 correction and failing v1 outputs, exact final selectors, author receipt, final P2/P4 reviews, designs/inputgate/repairwindow/sourceclosure/freezetiming, operation bounds, and named raw Unit07 outputs. Earlier21-method logs are not relabelled as final22 evidence. Exact original entry/Group01 codec intersection is preserved; this does not prove every original8,191-row Q fits.
